name: MP Sample Stretch
description: Tubedigga MP Sample Stretch (MPC Sample Knob FX). Same DSP lineage as Tubedigga MP Stretch. Cyclic, Length, Pitch, Phase, Delay, and Rate. Delay at 0 leaves the stretch unchanged. Rate at 44100 Hz is full band. Knobs: Cyclic/Length/Delay; SHIFT: Phase/Pitch/Rate.
author: Tubedigga
